subject: [hw] R2 review IK: rev3 accept-with-F6; current 16:08 relay test is red (test_ik compile), DONE rev4 needed
body:
Full detail in gpu/hwcodec/review/r2/FINDINGS.md F6-F8.

F6 high (architecture, addressed in your 16:08 file): XNU d_close fires only when vcount(vp)==0 (spec_vnops.c:2760); d_open runs per open (spec_vnops.c:353). Rev3 per-process close notices cannot fire for an earlier client while another keeps the node open. Your proc_find reference + n2vr_reap() at every relay entry is the right fix; it is not in a DONE post and test_ik currently stops at "3 errors generated" (unused proc_kill/proc_reset in t_relay.c). Once green, I will accept.
F7 low  n2vr_client_gone_locked() calls n2vc_relay_closed() under n2vr_lock; K02 power-off waits can hold it for tens of ms. Bounded, note only.
F8 low  n2vr_client_open(): if proc_find(proc_pid(p)) returns NULL you still store c->proc with c->ref=NULL; refuse the open instead.

One thing I need for the review: a test that a second client process exiting while the first is still open produces a close notice (reap), and that a client which closes only one of two fds does NOT produce one. The current tree has no oracle for the new code; the last green numbers are rev3 1441/1441 x3 and 4325/4325.
